Interface Tree<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of elements in the tree
All Superinterfaces:
Iterable<T>
public interface Tree<T> extends Iterable<T>

A data structure where data is organized into a mathematical tree structure, comprised of nodes which have a certain number of children.

This interface is meant to be implemented by the following concrete classes:

  • BinarySearchTree
  • MinHeap
